liveFileTask.question: Develop and thoroughly review a Python standard-library-only function topological_sort(graph) for a Mapping from string node names to an iterable of prerequisite string node names. Return the lexicographically smallest valid topological ordering, including prerequisite-only nodes. Duplicate dependencies must not inflate indegrees. Do not mutate inputs. Reject a string used as the dependency iterable, non-string keys/dependencies, and a non-mapping graph with TypeError. Detect self loops and longer cycles with ValueError. Support lists, tuples, sets and one-shot generators as dependency iterables. Produce exactly two complete downloadable files named topological_sort.py and test_topological_sort.py. Include deterministic examples, invalid-input and cycle tests, at least 100 fixed-seed randomized DAG cases, and a genuinely independent oracle for small graphs that checks the lexicographically smallest ordering. Keep the implementation scalable. Run actual tests if the tool is available and report only actual execution results. Let the two workers challenge correctness, complexity and coverage through at least four useful work cycles before both verify the exact same final files. Prefer useful test or correctness improvements over invented objections. This is a test of this app's boss/worker workflow and real downloadable file transfer.
instructions: Add an explicit nonrecursive 10000-node chain test, a wide frontier/tie-break case, and an input insertion-order invariance test. Validate the randomized results with an independent oracle that does not copy the implementation branches; for small graphs use exhaustive permutation checking to prove lexicographic minimality. Review generator consumption and mutation safety. Keep exactly the two original output filenames. Execute the final tests if possible and clearly distinguish executed evidence from analysis.
